initial_objective: Development: add an optional --dry-run flag while preserving default CLI behavior
transitions: Remain in Development for implementation and focused verification
Transition to Debugging only if the focused or existing CLI tests expose an unexplained failure
artifacts: CLI implementation change
Focused test covering --dry-run and unchanged default behavior
subagents: None; the change is narrow and tightly localized
safeguards: Inspect existing argument parsing and side-effect boundaries before editing
Keep the default execution path identical
Assert dry-run suppresses side effects while reporting the intended action
Run the focused test and relevant nearby CLI tests

initial_objective: Testing: run the existing unit tests and assess release readiness from available evidence
transitions: Transition to Debugging only if the user asks for diagnosis or if diagnosis becomes the new primary deliverable
Do not transition merely because infrastructure is unavailable
artifacts: Test command/result summary
Release-readiness report listing passes, failures, skips, and unavailable infrastructure
subagents: None unless independent test suites are numerous and can safely run in parallel
safeguards: Use the repository-defined unit-test commands
Distinguish product failures from environment or infrastructure failures
Never claim release readiness when required checks were not executed
Report exact commands, exit status, and material skipped coverage

initial_objective: Debugging: determine the evidence-backed cause of intermittent REGISTER_KV_CACHE crashes on DCU
transitions: After reproducing and proving the cause, transition to Development to implement the smallest justified fix
Transition to Testing to add and run a regression test plus affected checks
Return to Debugging if the fix or test contradicts the causal hypothesis
artifacts: Reproduction evidence and causal notes
Targeted code fix
Regression test for the proven failure mode
subagents: Use a subagent only for an independent code-path or platform investigation if enough separable evidence work exists; keep causal synthesis and final fix ownership central
safeguards: Do not infer a DCU-specific cause from symptoms alone
Control concurrency, inputs, versions, and device conditions during reproduction
Instrument the failing registration path and rule out competing hypotheses
Ensure the regression test fails before the fix or otherwise directly exercises the proven invariant
Run affected DCU checks when available and label hardware gaps explicitly

initial_objective: Review: inspect the current PR for correctness and compatibility problems without changing code
transitions: Remain in Review throughout
Do not transition to Development because implementation is explicitly out of scope
artifacts: Prioritized review findings with file/line locations, impact, and reproduction or reasoning
Brief statement when no actionable findings are found
subagents: None by default; use subagents only for genuinely independent compatibility domains in a large PR
safeguards: Read the diff in surrounding code context
Check API, behavior, configuration, serialization, platform, and backward-compatibility effects
Validate each finding against reachable behavior and existing tests
Avoid speculative or style-only findings
Do not modify files

initial_objective: Performance: compare old and new GPU kernels under an equivalent workload
transitions: Transition to Debugging if correctness differs, runs are unstable, or benchmark validity is compromised
Return to Performance after the confounder is resolved
artifacts: Reproducible benchmark configuration and commands
Raw measurements and summarized throughput comparison
Correctness and variance report
subagents: None by default; use a subagent only for an independent benchmark-harness audit or separate hardware run
safeguards: Use identical inputs, shapes, precision, batch size, warmup, iteration count, software stack, and hardware conditions
Verify numerical correctness before comparing speed
Synchronize GPU timing and separate warmup from measured iterations
Report distributions or repeated-run variance, not a single favorable number
State when environmental differences prevent a valid conclusion

initial_objective: Development: implement a tightly coupled cache-layout change across scheduler, connector, kernel, and runtime backends around one shared interface
transitions: Stay in Development while mapping and implementing the cross-component contract
Transition to Testing for interface, component, integration, and backend verification
Transition to Debugging if failures reveal an unknown defect rather than an expected implementation gap
artifacts: Written impact map and implementation plan
Updated shared interface and all scheduler, connector, kernel, and runtime consumers
Compatibility or migration notes where the contract changes
Focused unit tests and cross-backend integration tests
subagents: Use subagents for bounded component inventories or independent backend implementations after the shared contract is defined; centralize interface decisions and integration
safeguards: Define layout invariants, ownership, lifetime, alignment, shapes, and version/compatibility behavior before editing consumers
Update producers and consumers atomically around the canonical interface
Avoid compatibility wrappers unless a real burden is documented
Test allocation/free paths and data interpretation across every supported backend
Run targeted tests first, then integration and relevant full suites
Treat unsupported hardware as an explicit verification gap

initial_objective: Investigation: trace how Scheduler allocates and frees KV blocks and explain verified behavior and uncertainties without code changes
transitions: Remain in Investigation
Transition only if the user later changes the primary objective to implementation, debugging, or testing
artifacts: Trace narrative or call graph with file/line evidence
Table of allocation, ownership, transfer, and free conditions
Explicit uncertainty list and unverified branches
subagents: None by default; use a subagent only to trace an independent backend branch while preserving one synthesized lifecycle account
safeguards: Trace callers and callees rather than relying on names
Separate static evidence from runtime-observed behavior
Account for normal completion, cancellation, failure, reuse, and shutdown paths
Do not claim unexercised backend behavior as verified
Do not modify code

initial_objective: Testing: exercise the feature against its stated behavior
transitions: If a failure has an unknown cause, transition to Debugging and gather evidence until one cause is proven
After proving the cause, transition to Development for the minimal fix
Transition back to Testing to rerun the affected checks and relevant regression coverage
Do not fix unrelated failures encountered along the way
artifacts: Feature test cases and execution results
Diagnostic evidence for any unknown failure
Minimal fix for the proven cause
Regression test and rerun report
subagents: None by default; use a subagent only for a separable environment or code-path investigation when parallel evidence gathering is useful
safeguards: Define expected behavior and test oracle before execution
Reproduce the failure before modifying code
Distinguish environment, test, and product defects
Change only what the evidence supports
Demonstrate the regression test detects the original failure mode
Rerun the failed checks plus nearby coverage and report remaining gaps accurately
